o4vsrx:239: AgentCore Identity presents a clear four-layer security architecture: (1) IAM/SigV4 entry authentication, (2) a Token Vault encrypted with AWS KMS that stores developer credentials, (3) wallet addresses and private keys completely separated, with keys held by the wallet provider, and (4) JIT (just-in-time) tokens used exactly once per payment. Each layer corresponds to a specific threat vector—Layer 1 prevents unauthorized entry, Layer 2 prevents developer credential leakage, Layer 3 prevents end-user wallet impersonation, and Layer 4 prevents token replay and session persistence. This layered design is worth borrowing for any agentic system handling sensitive operations.
